notes:
REF-BM-02: Saving without the separate Fetch step does not collect or persist title and description automatically, though images are enriched in the background.
REF-BM-20: Multi-selection supports most listed actions in the UI, but removing tags is only implemented server-side and has no user control.
REF-BM-21: The UI exposes all-matching actions only for a query or saved filter with off-page results, not an unfiltered perspective, and omits tag actions.
REF-BM-29: Saved-filter storage supports included and excluded tag IDs, but the UI can only create a bundle from the current search expression.
